blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Give each task relevant context, clear boundaries and checkable evidence. Context is finite, and a larger window does not ensure attention to every detail. Basic API calls do not inherently remember earlier conversations.

blocks.title: Focused context
items: Goal and expected result
Relevant requirements and constraints
Current errors and observed behavior
Involved files or source passages
Remove unrelated history and stale details

blocks.title: Reviewable slices
items: Give each slice a deliverable and done condition
Agree on inputs, outputs and behavior at interfaces
Separate work that can proceed independently
Review parts before integrating and checking the whole

blocks.title: Grounding labels
items: Source: stated or shown in supplied evidence
Inference: a reasoned conclusion, with its reasoning
Unknown: support is missing or insufficient
Citation: an inspectable source and location

blocks.title: Useful handoff
items: Goal, current state and next action
Changed files or areas and important decisions
Commands actually run and observed results
Checks not run, unresolved failures and remaining risks

blocks.title: Current project brief
items: User goal, scope and non-goals
Architecture, layout and conventions
Exact setup and verification commands
Observable acceptance checks
Revise entries when decisions or commands change

blocks.body: Do not turn a fluent answer, retrieved passage, planned test or passing check into proof beyond its evidence. Inspect sources and keep uncertainty visible.
